title: Qt: Add a pref for column text caching, and have it affect sorting
description:
Introduce a preference for the number of rows whose column text can
be cached, and allow sorting of the packet list only when the
number of displayed rows can fit in the cache. This preference only has
an effect for sorting based on columns that require dissection and
caching the column text. This reduces the number of dissections from
O(N log N) to N. Subsequent sorts are even faster.
    
Columns based on frame data are unaffected, as they sort much faster
as dissection is not required.
    
Set the size of the QCache introduced in 8c6854fb653cf58df39 based
on this preference.
    
Send a temporary status message to the status bar if we try to sort
but there are too many rows, explaining why sorting did not happen and
that the layout preferences can be changed.

Ping #18741

Changed the approach to a simpler one that works well I think.

A couple nits I'd like to fix - the width of the QLineEdit is too large, and I'm not sure what the text should say for the preference QLabel, since it only has an effect on columns not based on frame data.

added 34 commits
  • d30aa73b...3120e645 - 33 commits from branch wireshark:master
  • 1c01d3f4 - Qt: Add a "maximum number of rows" pref for sorting the packet list
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/9222/diffs?diff_id=570201721&start_sha=d30aa73b27e8a4e774db0a8e76587cb3c4bc3ea8)

Fixed the line edit issue.

This reduces the time when sorting by columns that require packet dissection back to what it was before !9143, because packet dissection only has to be done N times instead of O(N log N) with the columns cached.

The default number of columns / size of the column cache is arbitrary here, and I'm open to suggestions of a different default that balances memory use versus sorting.

I struggle a bit with how to express the preference to the user, because it only affects certain columns, those that require dissection instead of being based on frame data stored directly in the capture file format. All custom columns are affected, but also things like source and destination address. On the other hand, the built in overall packet length field is fine to sort by.
